scripts.deploy: pnpm -C ../user-ui build && pnpm typecheck && vite build && wrangler deploy
scripts.//deploy: Builds the USER UI first, BY PATH. It is served from this package's dist/client/u but is a separate package with its own build, so a stale bundle used to ship whenever it was not rebuilt. `pnpm --filter user-ui` was tried and is worse than nothing: control-plane is not a pnpm workspace, so it matches no project, prints 'No projects matched', and EXITS 0 — a build step that silently does nothing and reports success. `-C` takes a path and fails loudly.
